personality_one_liner: A premium, minimalist, and highly readable marketplace that lets the property and service content be the undeniable hero.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, comfortable touch targets. Minimal nesting. Use flex gaps over margins.

do's: Use blur on the sticky top header (search and segmented controls).
Use blur on the bottom tab bar.
Use blur on the floating action button (FAB) background.
dont's: Do not use blur on standard cards or list items.
Do not blur images directly without a solid or tinted underlay for text contrast.

screens.name: Market
screens.purpose: A multi-vertical marketplace to browse brand stores, book FIXA home services, and buy/sell pre-owned items.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the grid (Brands/Declutter) or list (FIXA) layout.
states.empty: A clean illustration with a brief message ('No items found in this category') and a CTA to clear filters or try another city.
states.error: Readable error message with a 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Sticky Header: Glass background. Top row has AMASS logo, FIXA brand integration (shield/text), and persistent Location selector dropdown. Second row: Airbnb-style floating search input and a distinct Filter icon button next to it (with active count badge). Third row: Segmented control (Brands, FIXA Services, Declutter) full width. ScrollView Body: 1. Horizontal Category Chips rail (`surfaceSecondary` bg). 2. 'Featured' horizontal rail for boosted items. 3. Main Feed: 2-column grid for Brands & Declutter, 1-column list for FIXA ProviderCards. Floating CTA FAB pinned at bottom right (safe area aware).

components.ClassifiedCard: For Brands/Declutter. Vertical layout, `surface` bg, `md` radius, 1px `border`. Image top (50-60% height) with vertical gradient scrim at bottom. Price pill floating bottom-left of image (`surfaceInverse` bg). Text below: Title (`base`, `onSurface`), City/Time (`sm`, `muted`). Heart icon top-right floating.
components.ProviderCard: For FIXA services. Horizontal list layout. Avatar left (circular) with verify badge overlapping. Right side: Name, Trade chip (`brandTertiary` bg, `onBrandTertiary` text), Rating/Jobs stats, and a 'Book Now' primary action button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. The UI should prioritize content over chrome, using generous spacing and clean typography (max weight 500).
Replace legacy 800/900 weight system fonts with `Plus Jakarta Sans` for a highly readable, Redfin-inspired accessible hierarchy.
Implement Airbnb's minimal search block layout: Use a sticky glass header (`expo-blur`) containing the location, floating search bar, and segmented control.

The filter flow should use a hybrid approach (learned from research): Keep category chips horizontally scrollable for instant access, while complex filters live inside a Bottom Sheet accessed via a dedicated filter button.

Design the `ClassifiedCard` to be information-dense yet visually clean. Ensure the image has a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so the overlapping price/badges remain legible (WCAG AA).
Integrate the FIXA branding smoothly inside the 'FIXA Services' section without causing clutter. Use the FIXA Green (`#22C55E`) selectively for relevant badges and verification marks.
Keep the Sell/Join CTA anchored as a Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right, with its label changing dynamically depending on the active segment.
